R5_causal_fix: Recovery Stop reporting captures the mailbox epoch. Following await completion, pendingControl must be nil AND inputs.ifCurrent must still own that captured epoch before stopDeadline/cancelAt clearing/admission enable execute. All three actions share the mailbox lock, so a control that already advanced the epoch cannot be overlooked merely because await selected report completion first. Failed ownership retains the first cancellation timestamp and existing timer, sets idleControl and immediately continues to consume/process the control. A control admitted after successful recovery begins a legitimately new cancellation interval. Existing cancelWait remains exactly three seconds.

input_starter.type: inputStarter func(*os.File, io.Writer, func(terminalInput), func() bool, ...func(rune) (string, string, bool)) func()
input_starter.defaults: Public Run still calls runWithTranscript with openTranscript; unchanged runWithTranscript signature delegates to runWithInput with terminalLoop. Existing tests require no adaptation. The supplied starter receives the existing production admission, epoch-binding/mailbox emit and request-choice callbacks; returned restore is deferred as before.
input_starter.scope: Unexported dependency only; no environment option, public API, fake mailbox/controller, public test behavior or production terminal change.
input_starter.R1_writer_handoff: Wrap the starter's actual terminalLoop emit callback or retain the provided callbacks. Call the real admit callback for ordinary text, park its accepted terminalInput before forwarding emit, insert an interrupt with the real emit callback, await protected input_control, then release that original accepted input. Its old admission epoch must survive insertion and produce explicit acceptance/cancellation with zero raw prompt bytes. Only after its release call admit for later explicit recovery input. Preserve production serialization of ordinary admit/emit pairs: do not admit a second ordinary input while the first is parked, since the terminal's admissionEpoch handoff intentionally has one ordinary producer. Controls may be emitted separately without calling admit.
input_starter.byte_writer_handoff: Feed complete strings using accepted := admit(); emit(terminalInput{text: text, accepted: accepted}). Hold an actual active turn to retain queued reservations. Cover ordinary individual UTF-8 sizes at 1MiB-1, 1MiB, 1MiB+1, and aggregate waiting reservations at 8MiB-1, 8MiB, 8MiB+1 while staying below the 32-entry count limit. Use the real transcript and raw ACP correlation; no rune-by-rune PTY redraw is needed. The starter can delegate terminalLoop for ordinary control/cleanup keys while exposing complete-input injection.
input_starter.R5_writer_handoff: The same real control emit callback can place a newer interrupt while recovery Stop reporting is held at the existing reporter barrier. Release the report with a pending control wake and verify the original first-control time bounds any subsequent blocked protected operation. The new implementation's completion-first path checks mailbox ownership even with pendingControl nil. A causal regression must exercise that completion-first ordering, not only the already covered await-control-first branch. No new regression is claimed here.
